user.title: Connect to Hisho
user.description: Hisho Core's address, as this Home Assistant reaches it (for example {example_url}), and the read-only token from `hisho home-assistant token`.

data_description.url: Where Hisho Core answers. Over Tailscale, its https ts.net name.
data_description.token: Made on the Core machine with `hisho home-assistant token`. It can read Hisho's state and nothing else.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a Core with a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Hisho needs a new token
reauth_confirm.description: Hisho at {url} no longer accepts the saved token (it was rotated). Make a new one on the Core machine with `hisho home-assistant token --rotate` and paste it here.

reconfigure.title: Change the Hisho connection
reconfigure.description: Use this when Hisho Core moves to another address, or with a new token.

data_description.token: The read-only token from `hisho home-assistant token`.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a Core with a self-signed certificate.

error.invalid_auth: Hisho refused the token. Make one with `hisho home-assistant token` on the Core machine.
error.not_hisho: Something answered at that address, but not Hisho Core (or a Hisho too old to have the Home Assistant route).
error.unsupported_schema: This Hisho sends data version {schema}, newer than this integration understands. Update the integration in HACS.

abort.wrong_hisho: That address is a different Hisho than the one this entry belongs to. Add it as a new integration instead.

unsupported_schema.message: Hisho sends data version {schema}, newer than this integration understands. Update the integration.
